claims.object_text: very early-onset ataxia and CA with cortical hyperintensities
claims.quote: Eleven patients showed very early-onset ataxia and CA with cortical hyperintensities caused by mutations in ITPR1, KIF1A, SPTBN2, PLA2G6, PMPCA, and PRDX3.
